label_choice_rationale: BLOCKED_DATA_CONTRACT is reserved by the track spec for the case where the selector works but the data does not. The selector does not work, so BLOCKED_SELECTOR is primary. Both are recorded because closing only the selector would not open the pose layer.

eval_cad.note: genuine two-class discrimination; a constant predictor caps at 15/18

eval_noapril.note: constant guess scores the same; not evidence

selector.structural_reason: plastic footprint 1.10 m x 1.30 m, aspect ratio 1.182; swapping the two is an 18 percent change that unknown yaw and depth largely absorb

leakage.verification_method: read the function signature, not the contract's own claim
leakage.evidence: challenge/evaluation_v2/pnp_selector.py:495 select_pnp_hypotheses(predicted_keypoints, camera_intrinsics, physical_dimensions, config); zero references to gt_/ground_truth/target_pose in the file; the result's axis_assignment is an output
leakage.implication: the reported 0.5929 / 0.6500 are already honest values, not numbers that would fall once a leak is removed

SELECTOR_SOURCE.caveat: this source has already been used; synthetic dev balanced accuracy 0.904 / AUROC 0.966 versus 0.59-0.65 on real. The bottleneck is sim-to-real transfer, not data volume.

disqualifications: no selector labels: axis_assignment_confirmed absent on all 409 legacy_unverified pose frames
DATASET_CONTRACT defines DEV_UNVERIFIED as 'preserved legacy annotation, not paper eligible'
sample too small for the gates: 95 percent interval around 0.95 is about +/-3.9pp at n=121, and +/-6.5pp at night n=43

POSE_FINAL.reason: all five FINAL manifests are empty; 146 of the 229 physical FINAL frames are absorbed into PAPER_EVAL by SHA; and with zero axis-confirmed frames the evaluator would have to receive the GT axis again

axis_confirmation.consequence: no axis-confirmed real pose ground truth exists anywhere in the repository

wood.actual_blocker: freezing wood requires editing challenge/real_gt_v2/OBJECT_GEOMETRY_REGISTRY.json, whose sha256 is pinned in 62 files across 198 places

implementation_gaps_found_by_reading_cod: IoU3D absent from challenge/evaluation_v2/; exists only at scripts/stage0/real_eval/re_metrics.py:171
pose_auc exists twice with different discretisation: pose_metrics.py:297 (normalised errors, 1001 steps) and re_metrics.py:73 (raw errors plus diameter, 100 steps)

options: A: re-issue the registry with wood frozen and update all 198 pins
B: exclude wood from the pose table and report wood for detection and 2D only
decisions_awaiting_user.recommendation: B costs nothing and matches the current paper; A is only worth it if a wood selector is expected to pass a gate that plastic already failed

decisions_awaiting_user.question: approve training an appearance-based semantic-axis head on synthetic supervision
against: the dimension-based version of this already exists and scores 0.904 synthetic against 0.59-0.65 real
a learned polarity predictor in this repository went 0.95 synthetic to 0.023 real
the gate requires night >= 0.90 and night is the weakest condition
for: the dims-shuffle ablation dropping to 0.745 shows the existing head learned dimensions, which is exactly the signal that does not survive an 18 percent aspect ratio; an appearance cue is a different input
